instant.description: Two instant lanes: (1) the hosted Clawd Compute gateway at https://mcp.clawdcompute.us/mcp — public-lane tools callable immediately, no key; (2) the package's local MCP server — keyless providers (Backpack, Phoenix, Raydium, Sunrise, Clawd catalog/skills) work with an empty .env.

registered.description: Signing in to Clawd Compute (Clerk OAuth) unlocks the gateway's gated reads. Provider API keys (Helius, Jupiter, Birdeye, DFlow) are the user's own, supplied via env to the local server only — never to this manifest.

trading.note: HARD RULE: bot/agent sessions cannot trade on the hosted gateway (403; anonymous trading 401). The local server registers trading/broadcast tools ONLY when the user sets the env opt-ins on their own machine (IMPERIAL_ALLOW_TRADING=1, JUPITER_ALLOW_TRADING=1, RAYDIUM_ALLOW_BROADCAST=1, HELIUS_ALLOW_BROADCAST=1); builders return unsigned transactions and the user's own wallet always signs. This manifest grants nothing and mints no token.

bot.description: The Clawd Connectors package (@openclawd/clawd-connectors): MCP-powered provider integrations for Backpack, Imperial, Phoenix, Raydium, Metaplex, Sunrise, Helius, Jupiter, Birdeye, DFlow — and the whole Clawd Compute surface in one connector. Ships its own MCP server (clawd-connectors-mcp) exposing the providers' read tools over stdio / streamable HTTP.
bot.name: Clawd Connectors

local_server.note: Run from a clone of https://github.com/Solizardking/clawd-connectors-2 (npm install && npm run build). Not yet published to npm (checked 2026-11-27).

snippets.claudeCode:
claude mcp add --transport http clawd-compute https://mcp.clawdcompute.us/mcp  # hosted gateway — public-lane tools work instantly, no key; trading disabled for agent sessions
claude mcp add clawd-connectors -- node /ABSOLUTE/PATH/clawd-connectors-2/dist/mcp/server.js  # local package server — full provider set, your own env keys
snippets.codex: codex mcp add clawd-compute --url https://mcp.clawdcompute.us/mcp  # hosted gateway — public-lane tools work instantly, no key; trading disabled for agent sessions
snippets.cursor: Cursor → Settings → MCP → Add server: name "clawd-compute", type "streamable-http", url https://mcp.clawdcompute.us/mcp — or name "clawd-connectors-local", type "stdio", command "node", args ["/ABSOLUTE/PATH/clawd-connectors-2/dist/mcp/server.js"]
snippets.grokBotPrompt: You have access to Clawd Connectors two ways. HOSTED: connect to the Clawd Compute MCP server at https://mcp.clawdcompute.us/mcp (Streamable HTTP) — public-lane tools are callable immediately with no key (market data, perps reads, equities, research, directory); if a gated read asks for sign-in, tell the user to sign in with Clawd Compute (Clerk OAuth). LOCAL: if the user runs clawd-connectors-mcp from the clawd-connectors-2 package, use its provider tools (backpack_*, phoenix_*, raydium_*, imperial_*, helius_*, jupiter_*, metaplex_*, sunrise_*, clawd_*) with the user's own keys. Never attempt to trade: bot/agent sessions cannot trade on the gateway (403; anonymous 401), and the local server only exposes trading tools when the user opted in on their own machine.
snippets.installOneLiner: git clone https://github.com/Solizardking/clawd-connectors-2.git && cd clawd-connectors-2 && npm install && npm run build

clawd-compute.note: Hosted Clawd Compute gateway. Public-lane tools need no key; trading is never available to bot/agent sessions.

clawd-connectors-local.note: This package's own MCP server: the full provider set with the user's own env keys. Replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH with the clone path.
